title: mariscus brevibracteatus
intro: Mariscus brevibracteatus, commonly known as Marsh Cinnamon, is a type of plant species in the family Cyperaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties which help to reduce pain and swelling, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Mariscus brevibracteatus include antioxidant, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mariscus brevibracteatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
